The first edition of the **INDEMIC Seminar Series** featured **Fadilah Ilahi**, a lecturer in the Department of Mathematics at UIN Sunan Gunung Djati Bandung, Indonesia, and a PhD candidate at the University of Manchester, United Kingdom.

Fadilah presented her work on **"The construction of matrices for history-based multi-strain model"** — a mathematical framework relevant to modelling pathogens where prior infection history shapes individual immunity and disease dynamics, such as dengue and influenza.
